fit_reason: Although posted under boats by owner, this listing reads as dealer/marina stock: it is shown in a marina showroom, offers free winterization and storage as a purchase bonus, mentions a trailer available on request, and directs buyers to call Knotty Oar Marina. It is not a private-owner sale.
findings: Black fence panels on both sides look glossy, with no visible fading or chalking
Pontoon tubes look bright and clean, with no visible waterline scum
Beige vinyl seating throughout looks clean, with no visible staining
Helm console and seagrass flooring look clean and uncluttered
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Crest 240 pontoon. It already looks very clean, with glossy black panels and bright tubes. If you ever want a pre-sale or end-of-season detail done on site, we come to you and would be glad to give you a quote.
